title: Programme Outcome Summary

storyline.headline: Leadership needs a concise outcome signal
storyline.summary: An education provider wants an evidence-based summary of learner scores before changing a programme.

objectives: Calculate basic statistics for the learner outcomes.
starterCode:

scores = pd.read_csv('scores.csv')
hints: A summary statistic reduces many rows to a clear business signal.
